name: ea-leak-fixture
title: ea-leak-fixture
author: Jake Mismas
description: Test-only fixture presets for the isolation checks' positive controls: one redirects the keys fixture-names.lua lists for it (the mod's fine field, without its start mask), so vanilla starting ore reads the fine field and both isolation checks must report it; the other adds an entity and a decorative autoplace key redirected to fixture bodies that read the fine field, which the static walk must follow. The runner writes fixture-names.lua and the dependency on the mod under test into a staged copy at run time. Never shipped.
